content.text:
I can't compute these percentages. The working directory has no data in it. It holds only shell and editor config files (`.zshrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json` and similar) and the `.claude` settings folder. There are no IURC orders, no extracted case records, and no Abstentions field to count. I'm limited to this directory, so I didn't look elsewhere.

I also won't give an estimate. Nothing in the directory tells me how often these orders record an abstention, so any figure for 2021, 2024 or 2025 would be a guess.

To get the answer, I need the 58 orders (PDFs or text) or a table of their cases. Once I have them, I'll do the following:
1. Take each case's Abstentions field and delete any "Additional Infonnation:" or "Additional Information:" text.
2. Trim spaces, and count the case as having a recorded abstention if any text is left.
3. Group the cases by order year and report the share for 2021, 2024 and 2025, rounded to one decimal.
